review: I like the 10-second routes in Saw Mill and Crumble Bridge: moving saws and crumbling tiles reward a committed line, and Laser Gate has readable telegraphs with real timing risk. But the curve is broken. Spike Garden is stage 2 and stops 90 of 100 ghosts; the mid player stands in front of a double spike row for 45 seconds, and the same freeze appears in First Steps. Ferry Lines drops 87% of mid players into pits, too harsh for stage 4. Gauntlet kills almost everyone at one spring near 35% and even the expert gives up. Spring Loaded is safe but slow.
best: Saw Mill and Crumble Bridge give a fast, readable sub-10-second line with real risk.
worst: Spike Garden at stage 2 is a wall that even the high-skill player cannot pass.
